sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The prior instruction remains unmet: replace the presence-only memberCapacityMinimizationConfirmed assertion with explicit minimization semantics. The current SPARQL only finds a globally lowest represented capacity, does not bind the selected ice-load patch and its application location to each relevant structural-member load case, and permits unrelated cases/locations to satisfy the rule. Add the canonical relationship/path linking the I2.3 ice-load patch and its selected application location to the relevant structural-member load cases, then enforce the comparison over the correctly paired combined bending/shear cases and capacities.
